notes:
Summary: Aurora builds an IDE-integrated code assistant for enterprise repos (private monorepos, multi-branch). They want sub-100ms first-byte streaming to VS Code plugin, deterministic completions using repo-aware context, and strict EU data residency for source + embeddings.

Key asks: low-latency streaming (keystroke-level), per-repo embedding indices with branch/time tags, model/version pinning for deterministic QA, automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants under load, and audit logs for inference requests.

Onsecurity: must use customer-managed KMS, SSO/SAML for users, SOC2 compliance proof, and retention controls for embeddings (rolling 90-day TTL for dev data). Aurora prefers dedicated or private deployment; will consider hosted if residency guarantees are contractual.

Quote from CTO: "We need completions that never leak cross-repo data and must be able to pin models per-team — version drift is a showstopper."

use_case_summary: Primary product: IDE copilot plugin that uses repo-aware retrieval (embeddings + vector DB) to provide context-rich completions and in-editor code search. Workloads: low-latency streaming for token-by-token suggestions, batch reranking for PR suggestions, embeddings for semantic search across large monorepos.
technical_requirements: Performance targets: <=100ms first-byte for streaming completions in VS Code under p95 typing bursts (target 50-70ms in GA). Throughput: 200 simultaneous active devs per region with peak burst to 800 concurrent sessions. Retrieval: per-repo vector indices with per-branch and per-commit metadata tags; fast ANN queries (<15ms for top-20). Chunking: 256-token sliding windows for contextual snippets, similarity scoring + token budget-aware reranking. Models: pin stable generation model per team (e.g., gpt-4o-codex-2025-03) and fallback quantized variant for cost/latency; must support model version headers and predictable outputs. Residency: EU-only storage for certain repos (payroll, PII), with replication constraints and audit trail for cross-region access. KMS: customer-managed keys for embeddings at rest. Logs: token-level usage, request id, repo-id, branch, commit, user-id for audit; retention policy configurable (30/90/365 days).
poc_plan: Week 1: onboarding & network setup — provision VPC peering + KMS, confirm EU storage endpoints
Week 2: ingest pipeline — repo chunker prototype, embeddings pipeline, index into vector DB (small test repo)
Week 3: latency tuning — integrate streaming path to VS Code plugin, measure first-byte/word latency under synthetic typing
Week 4: correctness & safety — test model pinning, check cross-repo isolation, run evals on precision/recall for retrieval
Week 5: scale run — simulate 200 active devs, validate autoscaling and fallback behavior
Week 6: handoff — security review signoff, SLA & pricing finalization, rollout plan
